note: INTENDED DESIGN (plan ①). One flow diagram: the two changes meet on one path - the launch intent's command is now decided by a bound toggle (binding.fast, applied by the single launch.SetFastParam producer at both the render and the launch end), and the modeForm render becomes a composite (background by recorded formOrigin + a bordered box spliced over it) with a named small-terminal fallback. No sequence/class/state diagram: no new types beyond two fields and two pure helpers, no new runtime interaction with another process, and no new pipeline states (mode/status/classifier are untouched).

diagrams.title: Intended: the launch confirm renders as a modal composited over its recorded origin, and its per-launch fast toggle drives the exact command doLaunch runs
